sentences.text: Hmph. I fail to see how a haunting could be substantiated when the data shows nothing supernatural, only appliance activity in the house during the early morning hours, as recorded in E1.
The sensor data for E1 indicates that between 00:10 and 00:30, the machines woke up, registering 90 Wh of energy.
This observed energy usage (90 Wh) was significantly above the expected 40 Wh, and even outside the predicted range of 20 Wh to 54 Wh, according to E1.
I conclude that this spike was probably just a normal, albeit unexpected, surge in household appliance usage, rather than any ghostly disturbance, based solely on E1.
